work.title: What I do
work.statYears: years shipping production web applications in small, fast-moving teams.

about.title: About me
about.p1: I build modern, user-friendly software that serves business needs across the board. Precision and careful craftsmanship define how I work, whether it's a small UI detail or a more complex piece of backend logic.
about.p2: I love creating and building systems that real users actually use, day to day. That's what first drew me to engineering thinking in the first place turning an idea into a working, reliable product.
about.p3: What matters most to me is clarity interfaces that load fast, code the next developer can easily follow. I'd rather ship something small and solid than something overengineered and fragile.

contact.title: Let's build something.
contact.subtitle: Open to frontend, backend and full-stack roles, freelance builds and interesting problems. I reply quickly.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: I use Google Analytics to see how the site is visited and what works. It only loads if you agree. You can change your choice any time with the "cookie settings" link in the footer.
